name: codex-media-plugin
description: Unified Wsstudio media generation, conversion, workflow routing, and tool-discovery tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use Wsstudio media and workflow tools from one plugin.
interface.longDescription: Generate images and videos, convert video to GIF, run confirmed batch image jobs, prepare Codex_DT previews, route Codex Flow skills, and scout existing tools. Provider credentials, logs, and private runtime stay internal.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image from my prompt
Turn my reference image into a video
Convert these videos to GIF files
